title: A-FRAME SIGN STUDY
background: Identify which core messaging concepts and their placements on an A-Frame sign most effectively drive stop intent in a festival environment; as well as how this varies across different customer segments.
main_question: Imagine you are walking through a local outdoor market or festival. How likely are you to stop at a booth after seeing this sign?
orientation_text:
Welcome to the study!

Please imagine you are walking through a local outdoor market, farmers market, or festival and notice a booth sign.

Review each sign as you naturally would in that setting, then tell us how likely you would be to stop at the booth based only on the sign.

There are no right or wrong answers. We are interested in your honest first reaction.

classification_questions.question_text: What is your annual household income?
How often do you attend outdoor festivals in Metro Atlanta?

answer_options.text: At least a few times per year or more

classification_questions.question_text: Have you ever heard of the company Fresh Harvest before?
Have you ever used Fresh Harvest before?
Based on the signs you just reviewed, which statement BEST describes Fresh Harvest?

answer_options.text: An online farmers market with home delivery
A weekly produce subscription from one farm
A local grocery store or farmers market

classification_questions.question_text: Based on the A-Frame signs you just reviewed, do you believe this statement is True or False? Fresh Harvest charges a subscription fee.
Based on the A-Frame signs you just reviewed, do you believe this statement is True or False? Fresh Harvest allows you to customize every order.
Based on the A-Frame signs you just reviewed, do you believe this statement is True or False? Fresh Harvest is a big, national brand.
About how much does your household spend on groceries in a typical week?
How much of the groceries you purchase are organic?
How often do you intentionally buy locally-grown fruits and vegetables?
How often do you typically cook meals at home?

answer_options.text: Less than once per week or never
At least once per week, if not more

classification_questions.question_text: When you buy groceries, which of these do you prioritize the most?
When you buy groceries, which of the following do you prioritize the most?
